summary: Element-parameterized float accessor with an enable flag. Treats this as a byte buffer and computes an element base at byte offset 32 * a2. If the flag byte at element + 180 is nonzero it returns the float at element + 188 (v2[47]); otherwise it returns 0.0. A short conditional getter.

local_names.this: byte buffer of elements selected at 32-byte stride
local_names.a2: element index selecting the base at this + 32 * a2
local_names.v2: element base pointer reinterpreted as float array

operations.description: Element base pointer v2 computed as this + 32 * a2 (byte stride 32 per element)
Enable flag byte at element + 180 decides which value is returned
When the flag is nonzero, returns the float at element + 188 (v2[47])
Used on the frame path by ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch

unresolved: The role of the read-only float global flt_59E440: the packet lists it as read by this function but it does not appear in the decompiled body
The exact semantics of the enable flag at element + 180 (enabled state vs. cached/invalid marker) are not defined
